A page read twice is read once, if the first reading was slow.[^source]

## What a reader keeps

| Reading | Kept |
| --- | --- |
| Fast | Little |
| Slow | Most |

- the margins
- the notes

> A book is read with a pencil.

### In a terminal

```go
fmt.Println("slowly")
```
